[[Riverside, California]] }} '''Kawhi Leonard''' (born June 29, 1991) is an [[United States|American]] college [[basketball]] [[small forward]] with the [[San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball]] team. In 2009 as a senior at [[Martin Luther King High School (Riverside, California)|Martin Luther King High School]] in [[Riverside, California]], he was named [[California Mr. Basketball|Mr. Basketball California]]. A sophomore, Leonard was the [[2010 Mountain West Conference Men's Basketball Tournament]] MVP and a first team all MWC Conference selection as a freshman. As a freshman, Leonard led the MWC in rebounding.[http://goaztecs.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/leonard_kawhi00.html Player Bio] GoAztecs.com As a sophomore, he was picked to the Second Team All-America by [[Fox Sports]].{{cite news|first=Jeff|last=Goodman|url=http://msn.foxsports.com/collegebasketball/story/duke-blue-devils-notre-dame-fighting-irish-represented-postseason-honors-030711|title=Goodman's 2010-11 All-America teams|work=[[Fox Sports]]||publisher=Fox Sports Interactive Media|date=Mar 7, 2011|accessdate=June 21, 2011}} ==Personal== Leonard's father was shot and killed at a neighborhood car wash in January 2008.[http://msn.foxsports.com/collegebasketball/story/san-diego-state-forward-kawhi-leonard-stays-on-track-3-years-after-losing-his-father-011811 Father's memory helps drive Aztecs star] ''[[Fox Sports (USA)|Fox Sports]]'', January 20, 2011[http://www.craveonline.com/sports/article/kawhi-leonard-basketball-family-honor-125847 Kawhi Leonard: Basketball, Family, Honor] CraveOnline.com, March 11, 2011 ==References== {{reflist}} {{2011 NCAA Men's Basketball Consensus All-Americans}} {{Persondata | NAME = Leonard, Kawhi | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = | DATE OF BIRTH = | PLACE OF BIRTH = | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Leonard, Kawhi}} [[Category:1991 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball players]] [[Category:Small forwards]] [[Category:Basketball players from California]] [[Category:People from Riverside, California]] {{US-basketball-bio-stub}}
